title: Vertical Immersive | Higher Education Reimagined | Vertical Life
description: Vertical Immersive is a two-year, debt-free, Christ-centered program where young adults discover how God wired them and do real work for real businesses.

blocks.headline: Higher education, rebuilt around calling
blocks.body: A two-year, debt-free, Christ-centered program where young adults start their first semester doing real work for real businesses.

blocks.heading: Where the next generation gets formed
blocks.body:
Vertical Immersive is the education arm of Vertical Life. Instead of four years and a stack of loans, students spend two years discovering how God wired them and building a learning path around it.

Learning happens through real work, mentors and discipleship. In year two, students have the opportunity to secure a paid apprenticeship of their own.

**They graduate with real experience, a professional network and a faith that holds up under pressure.**

items.title: Discipleship first
items.body: Spiritual growth is the foundation, not an elective.

items.title: Real work, day one
items.body: Students do real work for real businesses from their first semester, including the Vertical companies.

items.title: Mentors, not lectures
items.body: Learn from leaders and business owners who do the work every day.

blocks.heading: See what students are up to
blocks.body: Explore programs, tours and admissions on the Vertical Immersive site, or book a tour to see it for yourself.
